case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Gegenangebot – 7,5-kW-Motor (part:350011)
move.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Lechner,

vielen Dank für Ihr Angebot offer:70510-0. Wir haben Ihre Angaben zum Anstieg der CU-NOTATION um 47,7 % und zum Kupferanteil von 20 % zur Kenntnis genommen.

Für die angefragten 6.110 Stück pro Jahr lautet unser Gegenangebot: EUR 1,00 pro Stück, Zahlungsziel 90 Tage netto, ohne Preisgleitklausel. Alle übrigen angefragten Konditionen bleiben unverändert.

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €374.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We assume your proposed price of EUR 1.00 is a placeholder, as it does not reflect the substantial raw material costs involved.
We are willing to accommodate your request for a 90-day payment term.
However, the extended payment period requires an adjustment to the unit price, leading to our revised offer of EUR 374.50 per unit.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
